title: Cross-Platform BI Adoption Trend
dataSources: Aggregated cat-24 indexes (BI usage, refresh/pipeline outcomes, data-quality incidents, cost/capacity metrics) summarised via `tstats`, `stats`, and summary indexing for adoption, SLA, and spend trends.
app: Cross-platform rollups over the indexes populated by the other cat-24 subcategories; Splunk ITSI (Splunkbase 1841) for service-level trending where available.
spl:
index=bi (sourcetype=tableau:httpd OR sourcetype=o365:management:activity OR sourcetype=looker:system_activity OR sourcetype=qlik:proxy)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval platform=case(sourcetype="tableau:httpd","Tableau",sourcetype="o365:management:activity","Power BI",sourcetype="looker:system_activity","Looker",sourcetype="qlik:proxy","Qlik")
| stats dc(user) as active_users by platform, _time
| sort _time
description: Rolls up active users per BI platform per day into one adoption trend, letting leaders compare tool usage and rationalise an overlapping BI portfolio.
value: Most enterprises run several overlapping BI tools; a unified adoption trend informs consolidation decisions worth significant license spend.
implementation: Summary-index daily active users per platform; schedule daily; chart the multi-platform trend for portfolio reviews.
visualization: Multi-series timechart of active users by platform, adoption leaderboard.

references.title: Splunk — Use summary indexing for increased search efficiency

grandmaExplanation: We show how many people use each of your reporting tools over time, so you can see which are worth keeping.
